raw_response:
This is my maize plot, and maize is what feeds my family, so I must do my best with it. I am getting older and my eyes are not strong, but I still work the ridges myself. If the chief's list gives me a coupon this year, I will buy one bag of NPK and one bag of urea like before — but I stretch it across this plot and a little of another, because I also grow beans intercropped here. I cannot afford pesticide, and the rains in Mulanje are enough, so I do not irrigate. Sometimes I pay a young man a few days of ganyu to help me make ridges, because my back is tired.
